finalReport:
# OpenCut automation capabilities — official vs roadmap vs community (Sept 2026)

**Bottom line:** As of Sept 2026, OpenCut has **no released official automation surface** for Editor API, MCP server, headless/CLI rendering, scripting, or portable interchange. All four programmable capabilities plus plugins are officially **roadmap/future for the ground-up Rust-core rewrite**. The only released persistence is **local browser storage**. A versioned JSON interchange exists only as **open PR**, a 9-tool MCP+bridge exists only as **closed PR**, and working MCP/headless-style automation exists only as **unofficial community Playwright workarounds targeting classic/forks**.

Current production (`opencut.app`) still runs `opencut-classic`; `main` is the incomplete rewrite. Do not treat contributor-internal `EditorCore`, third-party blog code sketches, or same-named `opencut` packages as official released APIs.

## 1. Editor API — roadmap, not released

No public, stable, documented Editor API is released.

- Official README lists “An Editor API” under “What’s coming” for the rewrite being built from the ground up: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/blob/main/README.md
- Tracking issue #811 defines it as “a clean, stable API anyone can build on top of” with unchecked “Editor API design”: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/811
- What *does* exist is the internal `EditorCore` singleton coordinating `playback, timeline, scenes, project, media, renderer, command, save, audio, selection` via `EditorCore.getInstance()` / `useEditor()`. Docs present this as core architecture for contributors, not a stable public automation API: https://opencut-app-opencut.mintlify.app/api/editor-core

**Verdict:** `not-found (released)` / `roadmap/official-future`.

## 2. MCP server — no official server; closed PR + community only

No official released MCP server.

- Official README lists “MCP server (for AI agents)” as “What’s coming”: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/blob/main/README.md
- Issue #811 lists “MCP server: for AI agents” with unchecked “MCP server”: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/811
- PR #752 proposed `packages/mcp-server` + `packages/ws-bridge` (WebSocket on :3001, `useWsBridge` hook) exposing 9 tools: `get_timeline, split, remove_range, trim, undo, redo, seek, play, pause`. Status is **Closed/unmerged** — i.e. proposed/experimental, not official release: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/pull/752
- Community: `JXUE0/opencut-controller` advertises 161 tools via Playwright, dual `stdio` + HTTP-streamable transport, resources/prompts, but explicitly **requires legacy `opencut-classic`** and patches the local editor — unofficial: https://github.com/JXUE0/opencut-controller
- Community PoC: `kenimo49/opencut-mcp` drives classic via `window.__editor` in Playwright, targets fork `kenimo49/opencut-classic` not upstream, self-labeled **PoC**, tools `get_state, add_track, add_media, insert_clip, split_at, move/trim/delete, undo/redo, export, screenshot`: https://github.com/kenimo49/opencut-mcp

**Verdict:** `roadmap (official)` / `experimental/closed-PR (#752)` / `community (JXUE0, kenimo49)`.

## 3. Headless editing/rendering — browser-only today; roadmap + open proposal

No official headless mode, CLI, batch queue, or server-side render service.

- Official README: “Headless mode (automation, batch rendering)” under “What’s coming”: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/blob/main/README.md
- Issue #811: “Headless mode: automation, batch rendering, CI pipelines” unchecked: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/811
- Current released path is in-browser `RendererManager.exportProject({format: mp4/webm, quality: low/medium/high/very-high, fps, includeAudio, onProgress/onCancel}) → ArrayBuffer` for download — GUI/browser export, not headless: https://opencut-app-opencut.mintlify.app/api/renderer-manager
- Concrete design exists only as open community proposal #778: `@opencut/render-sdk` library (`import {render}`) + CLI `opencut-render run draft.json -o out.mp4` + `RenderServer` for batch, driving headless Chromium via Playwright and reusing `editor.renderer.exportProject()` for byte-identical output, gated by `NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTOMATION=1` exposing `window.__opencutAutomation`. Author notes working local prototype (76/76 tests) and asks “Is this direction welcome upstream? If yes, I’ll split into incremental PRs” — i.e. **proposed, no PR merged**: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/778

**Verdict:** `roadmap (official)` / `proposed/open-issue (#778)` / `not-found (released CLI/headless)`.

## 4. Scripting interface / SDK — roadmap, no official language

No official scripting tab, JS/TS SDK, plugin SDK, or scripting language released.

- Official README: “A scripting tab directly in the editor” under “What’s coming”: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/blob/main/README.md
- Issue #811: “Scripting tab: write and run scripts directly inside the editor” unchecked, diagrammed as `Scripting → Rust core` alongside MCP/Headless, blocked on engine/UI separation: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/811

Illustrative `opencut.timeline.* / opencut.script.execute` snippets in third-party coverage are not official docs and must not be cited as released API.

**Verdict:** `roadmap` / `not-found (released)`.

## 5. Portable project interchange — local-only today; open JSON PR only

No released portable file; no OTIO/XML/EDL support found.

- Released behavior per docs: projects contain timeline, media assets, settings, history; storage is `IndexedDB for project data/metadata`, `OPFS` for media bytes, localStorage for prefs; “All data stays on your device / Nothing is sent to external servers”: https://opencut-app-opencut.mintlify.app/features/project-management
- Open issue #719 states: “OpenCut has no portable project file format. Projects are locked in IndexedDB/OPFS” and requests documented versioned JSON (tracks/clips/trim/transitions/overlays/audio/settings, media by filename) plus Export/Import buttons for AI/CLI pipelines: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/719
- Open PR #764 (unmerged, merge-conflicted) proposes `.opencut.json`: `{schema_version:1, exported_at, project: SerializedProject, media:[{mediaId,filename,type,size,width,height,duration}]}`; export serializes scenes/tracks/elements/settings + media manifest (blobs excluded); import validates (Zod: scenes→tracks→elements, settings, view state), mints fresh ID, opens editor; UI in projects page + editor header: https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/pull/764

**Verdict:** `not-found (released)` / `experimental/open-PR (#764)` addressing `open-issue (#719)`; `not-found: OTIO/XML`.

## 6. Released vs non-released map

| Capability | Released/official today | Experimental / PR | Roadmap (official future) | Community / proposed | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Editor API | No | — | Yes — stable API anyone can build on | Internal EditorCore is contributor-internal only | https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/811 https://opencut-app-opencut.mintlify.app/api/editor-core |
| MCP server | No | Closed PR #752 (9 tools + ws-bridge) | Yes — for AI agents | 161-tool Playwright servers (JXUE0, kenimo49) targeting classic/fork | https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/pull/752 https://github.com/JXUE0/opencut-controller https://github.com/kenimo49/opencut-mcp |
| Headless / CLI / batch | No — browser `exportProject` only | — | Yes — automation/batch/CI | Open proposal #778 (`render-sdk` + `opencut-render` CLI) | https://opencut-app-opencut.mintlify.app/api/renderer-manager https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/778 |
| Scripting tab / SDK | No | — | Yes — in-editor scripting tab | No official language/SDK | https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/811 |
| Interchange format | No — IndexedDB/OPFS local-only | Open PR #764 (`.opencut.json` + manifest) | Implied by Project storage rewrite item | Issue #719 request; DraftTemplate in #778 is proposal-only | https://opencut-app-opencut.mintlify.app/features/project-management https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/pull/764 https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/issues/719 |

No contradictions requiring resolution were found; third-party claims of “built-in MCP/headless” refer to roadmap language or community shims, not released official code.

## What to use today (with caveats)

- For local automation experiments only: run `opencut-classic` locally and use community Playwright MCP controllers that call `EditorCore`/`window.__editor` + `exportProject`. Expect fragility, version pinning to a fork commit, and no stability guarantee.
- Do not plan production on `Editor API`, official MCP, `opencut-render`, scripting tab, or `.opencut.json` until the rewrite’s Engine Core + API designs land and PRs #764/#752-successor merge.

*Scope: OpenCut-app/OpenCut (rewrite `main`) + opencut-classic docs/issues/PRs as of Sept 2026. Unrelated same-name `floomhq/opencut` (Remotion-based) excluded as name collision.*

OpenCut has no official scripting interface or SDK today; the scripting tab is roadmap/future tied to the Rust-core rewrite with no official language documented.

OpenCut has no released portable project interchange format and no OTIO/XML support; storage is local-only IndexedDB/OPFS, and versioned .opencut.json interchange exists only as open unmerged PR #764.

Status map: Editor API, MCP server, headless mode and scripting are roadmap-only (not released); local browser storage is the only released persistence; portable JSON is experimental PR-only; community MCP/headless workarounds are unofficial.
